qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Local manufacturing and distribution footprint creates a regional barrier due to weight-to-value transport economics in gypsum and insulation. However, cyclical exposure to new residential construction and capital intensity prevent sustained excess returns, with 5-year median GAAP ROIC hovering around 6-8%, well below the 12% hurdle.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC < 12%, REJECT). Heavy building products and materials manufacturer benefits from local plant density and energy-efficiency renovation demand, but structural capital intensity and cyclical new-build construction limit multi-cycle GAAP ROIC to ~6-8%.
qualitative.evidence: Multi-cycle GAAP ROIC hovers around 6.0-7.5% (GuruFocus), well below the 12% threshold despite portfolio pruning (divesting UK distribution, expanding in construction chemicals via Chryso and GCP). Group operating margin reached 11.4% in 2024, but goodwill and capital intensity dilute overall returns on capital.
